proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 5151 article gives Malayalam yāvan/ēvan, yāvaḷ/ēvaḷ, yāvar/ēvar/yār/ār who ( masc. sg., fem. sg., pl. ); yā/yātu/ētu/ēn, ēva what ( sg., pl. ); e, ē what; eṅṅu where; eṅṅum, eṅṅānum anywhere; eṅṅanē how; ettira, etra how much, how many; entu what; why; ennu what day, when; ennum,…. The Byari survey form evḍe “where” is proposed within this article family. Lindgren assigns the corresponding Tamil reflex to the same source cognate set.
